edits.old: **Event.** Publishes ParameterVersionApproved (new internal event, see additions: paramKeys, versionNo, validFrom) to the outbox; every instance refreshes its cache.
edits.new:
**Event.** Publishes rwb.case.ParameterVersionApproved.v1 on rwb.case.events.v1 with paramKeys, versionNo and validFrom to the outbox; every instance refreshes its cache, and the cache time to live is the fallback. The cache time to live is read from the catalog entry refdata.cache.ttl-seconds; the client does not read config.cache.ttl-seconds.

The client artefact coordinates (group, artefact name, version scheme and publication channel) are taken from the platform library baseline at version freeze and pinned in the service template.

**Contract artefact.** Version 1 (major) of the published client contract carries ParameterService, ParameterValue, the generated ParameterKeys, the catalog and value data contract DF-REF-132 to DF-REF-158, the consumed operations of this section with their status codes and message IDs, the cache and refresh rule, the start-up rule and the two build-check contracts, with a fake. It is frozen when the consuming stories pass their drift tests.

**Build-check contract.** The two build-check rule sets are the contract of RWB-PLT-E1042-CON: the literal values 0, 1 and -1 and test code are allowed, and test code is identified by path and by annotation.

**Chart values and probe.** The chart values are RWB_ENV, RWB_PARAMETER_CATALOG and RWB_PARAMETER_TTL_KEY; RWB_PARAMETER_TTL_KEY is a bootstrap time to live compared against the catalog entry at deployment. One parameter-catalog-seed hook runs before the rollout and fails the release when a key has no entry, owner or default. The probe runs the same check as the start-up check (X3). One page is raised for a missing required value; two warnings are raised for a stale cache and a failed refresh, from the library's own metrics.
